_about: Tool-call repair corpus (A4, 50+ cases). 'args' cases run repair_args against the named tool; 'text' cases run the text scanner, then the whole text is fed through the Ollama stream folder in pieces of 1, 3 and 17 characters and must give the same calls with no markup on screen. Cases credited to flashagent@0b08afc (MIT, github.com/flashback7766/FlashAgent) are adapted from its crates/llm/src/repair.rs and parse.rs tests; the inputs are theirs, the expectations are Marlowe's (one deliberate difference: a call cut off mid-value is never completed).
